$comment: Gzipped bytes. entry: the entry chunk with its static imports; routes: a route file's split chunks with the static imports the entry does not already load; css: all emitted CSS. A task that needs more raises the budget in the same PR and says why. U-02 raised entry from 150000 to 175000: the authenticated shell (sidebar, engine switcher, trust mark with SHA-256, user menu, drawer, step-up dialog, toaster, route states) and the Paraglide runtime with both catalogues render on every route, so they belong in the entry; measured 168130. Raised to 200000 on 2026-10-21 (Seb): at 173803 an audit of the entry found it is framework and contract code (react-dom, zod, TanStack Router and Query, engine-api schemas, @ptbk/ui shell components); Paraglide already tree-shakes messages per route, and the only engine-ui code left to split was route loaders (about 1 kB), not worth a serial chunk fetch before every cold navigation. U-04 gave the book editor and the create-agent wizard budgets of their own: both load CodeMirror 6 (view, state, language, lint, search, history; merge for the editor's diff), about 105000 shared, which the entry never loads (ADR 0013). Measured: agents/$agentId/book.tsx 158808 (CodeMirror with merge, the history DataTable), agents/new.tsx 158133 (CodeMirror, the form layer, the knowledge upload, the chat panel for the test step); the entry grew by 413 (the two routes' guards, search schema and loader, and the Book tab's registration). U-13 raised agents/new.tsx from 165000 to 168000: the test step carries the book editor's throwaway test chat beside the kept-chat fallback; measured 165022. U-13 raised agents/$agentId/book.tsx from 170000 to 171000: the trigger form reuses the book's unsaved-changes guard, so the guard moves into a chunk both routes share; measured 170200. Raised entry from 200000 to 215000 on 2026-11-03: home, where opening an engine lands, is no longer split from the entry (vite.config.ts). Split, it was 23 chunks of 17 kB gzip in all, fetched after the entry ran and queued behind HTTP/1.1's six connections; at Fast 3G its first screen went from 5.4 s to 3.4 s. Measured 209991.
